passages.excerpt_preview: The Rani first condemns the cruelty and violence of the forces of Jhansi who killed all the European civil and military officers, the clerks, and all their families.
The only possible verdict of history is, therefore, that the Rani of Jhansi had no share in instigating the mutiny
this circumstance will not protect her if her account shall turn to be false.
She also states that these forces acted rudely to her and extorted a great deal of money from her.
